text:
emma-cs: Aurora week0 sync — blocking items for private/VPC cutover: KMS key policy missing our service role, VPC egress only allows internet (we need proxy CIDR), and audit logs not flowing to our bucket. ETA request and owners?

raj-netops: I checked their SGs: outbound 0.0.0.0/0 on 443 only. We need 10.90.0.0/16 to reach our egress cluster + 10.90.2.0/24 for health checks. Also they use ephemeral NAT; ask for static NAT for jump host.

zoe-engr: Health checks: TCP 8081 and 9123. Splunk HF needs TCP 9997. Canary will also need S3 PutObject to the audit bucket.

ken-kms: KMS note: their key policy omitted arn:aws:iam::777888999:role/redwood-service. Decrypts fail with AccessDenied. Minimal add: Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey for that role. I can draft a short policy snippet.

ken-kms: snippet: {"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::777888999:role/redwood-service"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"}

harper-cust: splunk.aurora.prod:9997 (TCP), jump NAT temporary 198.51.100.99. Creating bucket now: aurora-redwood-audit. Will DM ARN + role names.

emma-cs: Actions: raj -> apply SG + static NAT and confirm, ken -> send policy PR + test checklist, zoe -> schedule canary and rollback steps, harper -> DM bucket ARN + confirm Splunk open. I'll tag renewal owner; timeline slip >7d is a risk.

ops-bot: canary-run:privnet-aurora passed in staging after policy applied. Link: https://ci.redwood/infer/2211

harper-cust: Policy applied and bucket ARN arn:aws:s3:::aurora-redwood-audit. Sent DM with IAM role.

emma-cs: Great — canary scheduled tomorrow 11:00-11:30 PST. I'll update onboarding tracker and escalation path for renewal risk. :white_check_mark:
